key_highlights: ASX slides as rising oil prices (Hormuz Strait escalation) fuel RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall
RBA deputy governor signals inflation remains a concern, raising expectations of further tightening
Iron ore under severe pressure; BHP faces strategic rethink as commodity price crumbles
Santos (STO.AX) under fire as gas cartel dynamics shift, pressuring energy sector
Yen surge disrupts global carry trades, pressuring AUD and risk assets
Gold miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Aureka) report strong discoveries amid safe-haven demand
Property sector faces structural stress; mortgage costs driving households into second jobs
China crude buying rebounds 29%, providing partial support to energy complex

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP strategising pivot. Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows and new discoveries. Carbon credit crash hits pastoral assets.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure. Gold names (FOR.AX, KAL.AX, MNG.AX, AUK.AX) attract rotation. Diversify away from iron ore concentration.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on rate-hike fears compressing net interest margins and raising credit-risk concerns. Mortgage stress rising among households.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. Rising default risk in property-linked lending. Monitor NIM vs credit-cost trajectory.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation spikes oil prices. Santos (STO.AX) faces regulatory and cartel-break scrutiny. China crude demand rebound supports LNG.
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, WEL.AX benefit from oil spike but face policy risk. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) supported by China demand.

sectors.trend: Living standards under pressure; households taking second jobs. Qantas (QAN.AX) $35m redundancy payout signals cost stress. BYD export surge pressures local auto.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WPG.AX defensive appeal rises. QAN.AX faces margin pressure. Consumer discretionary under stress.

sectors.trend: Property industry facing 'GFC moment'; NZ house price crash returns. Construction capacity deficit constrains supply. Mortgage rates easing slightly at week start.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk. Construction names (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) benefit from supply crunch.

sectors.trend: ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute creates regulatory uncertainty. CSL (CSL.AX) relatively insulated. Gold-tech and uranium exploration active.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX defensive. Tech names face ATO compliance risk. Uranium (INF.AX) and gold exploration (AUK.AX, LAR.AX) active.

key_themes: RBA inflation persistence and rate-hike risk
Iron ore structural decline and BHP strategic pivot
Geopolitical oil shock via Hormuz Strait
Property sector stress and living standards squeeze
Gold safe-haven rotation and ASX explorer activity
ATO vs Big Tech tax enforcement

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and property; favour fixed-income ladders. Monitor CPI print.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hormuz Strait escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour LNG exporters over pure-play oil. Monitor Brent/WTI spreads.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / BHP strategic risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and diversified miners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Yen surge / carry-trade unwind / AUD weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; monitor JGB yields and BOJ intervention signals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property sector credit stress / GFC-like conditions
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank credit-cost provisions; avoid high-LVR REITs. Monitor NAB/CBA loan-loss data.
Monitor ACCC actions; diversify energy exposure beyond STO.AX.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and explorers on safe-haven rotation
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser inventory reload, Aureka $8.9M acquisition signal sector strength amid geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long LNG exporters on China crude rebound
opportunities.rationale: China fuel exports jump 29%; LNG demand structural. WDS and BHP LNG arm benefit

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive consumer staples and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Living standards squeeze and rate-hike risk favour WES, WPG, CSL as defensive anchors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP strategic uncertainty; China demand softening for ore
Property 'GFC moment', NZ crash, mortgage stress, construction capacity gap all point to downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and reduce carry-trade exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Yen surge disrupting global positioning; AUD vulnerable to risk-off flows

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Rate-hike expectations, iron ore weakness, and Hormuz-driven oil volatility cap upside. Banks and miners drag index. Gold and defensives outperform. Expect 3–5% downside risk into RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots and iron ore stabilises. Gold, healthcare, and LNG remain structural winners. Property sector may see 12–18 month correction. BHP pivot could unlock value if executed. US midterms add volatility.

Iron ore price trajectory and BHP strategic announcement
Hormuz Strait geopolitical resolution or escalation
China stimulus and crude demand data
ATO vs Big Tech tax enforcement actions

Brent/WTI crude and iron ore (62% Fe) prices
ASX 200 bank index (^AXBK) and mining index (^AX20)
China PMI and crude import data
Gold price (XAU/USD) and ASX gold miners
Hormuz Strait shipping and insurance premiums
